policy.prompt: short Python file; actual engine token counts recorded
policy.generation_input: chat messages through the fixed template, thinking disabled
policy.sampling_noops: min_p and penalties are engine defaults/no-op; not extra request fields
policy.head_calibration: raw-T1, no fitting or model selection
policy.cache_policy: unique leading nonce for every pipeline/wave; within-pipeline AB reuse is intentional
policy.baseline: cross-configuration panel only; not a stock/fused speedup or fair comparison to the old unmatched-prefix run
